whatToWatch.text: That defense is the story: 8.5 points allowed per game through two weeks, and Washington has been coughing up 30.5. Seattle is 7.5-point road favorites for a reason — but this is the first real test of whether the Seahawks can travel with that edge.

Watch the secondary's availability. Seattle has one player out and four questionable, with Julian Love, Jadarian Price and Ty Okada on the report — if the back end is thinned out, the depth guys inherit a defense that's currently carrying this team.

The 40.5 total says everyone expects a rock fight, and both teams are getting 2.5 sacks a game. Washington has nobody ruled out and gets Chig Okonkwo and Jeremy Reaves back in the mix, so if Seattle wants the 3-0 start, the pass rush has to win the margins.
